highlights: Live vocals, guitar and percussion, plus DJ sets from the same duo
Music from the ceremony right through to the party
Sax, violin or trumpet can be added to the line-up
First-dance songs learned with at least six weeks' notice
PAT test and public liability documents emailed on request
A few public gigs each year, with dates posted on Instagram

howItWorks.title: Send your event details
howItWorks.text: Share as much as possible about the event: the venue and location, performance times, room or marquee size, guest numbers, and whether the venue has a sound limiter or a built-in sound system.

howItWorks.title: Receive a tailored quote
howItWorks.text: No two bookings are the same, so the duo prices each event from the details provided.

howItWorks.title: Secure the date
howItWorks.text: Once the booking is confirmed, a non-refundable deposit is expected within 30 days; otherwise the date may go to another client.

goodToKnow.text: When quoting, the duo needs to know if the venue has a sound limiter and whether it has a built-in sound system.

Bookings are secured with a non-refundable deposit, due within 30 days of the booking being confirmed. The FAQ and Book Now pages state different deposit percentages, so confirm the figure when booking.
Their summers are full of events, so new songs for a first dance or ceremony need at least six weeks' notice.
Lighting is not provided at present, though they may be able to suggest a supplier near the venue.
For events abroad, the client covers flights, accommodation, transfers and other trip costs on top of the performance fee.
The contact page lists hours of Monday to Friday 9am–6pm and Saturday 10am–7pm, and closed on Sundays.

faqs.a: There is no set price, as no two bookings are the same. For an accurate quote they ask for the venue, location, performance times, room or marquee size and guest numbers.

faqs.q: How do we secure a booking?
faqs.a: With a non-refundable deposit. Once the booking is confirmed, the deposit is expected within 30 days, or the date may be offered to another client.
Yes. Both members DJ, and they are comfortable with Jewish dancing, Bhangra and the many other genres that come up at weddings.

faqs.q: Will they learn our first-dance song?
faqs.a: Within reason, yes, and they often do. Because summer is busy with events, they need at least six weeks' notice to learn a first-dance or ceremony song.

faqs.q: Can we choose the songs in their sets?
faqs.a: A guide to what the crowd enjoys is enough for them to design the set. They are happy to leave out songs connected to bad memories, such as the loss of a loved one.

faqs.q: Do they have insurance and PAT certificates?
faqs.a: Yes. PAT test and public liability documents can be requested and are sent by email, and a repertoire list is available in the same way.

faqs.q: Can we see them perform before booking?
faqs.a: They play a few public performances each year, which they describe as a good chance to get a taste of what they do and meet them. Dates are posted on their Instagram.

faqs.q: Will they work with our other entertainers?
faqs.a: If they feel the combination will give a great performance, yes, and that includes working with external DJs.

serviceDetails.name: Acoustic performance
serviceDetails.more: A repertoire list is available on request. Their Videos page includes performances of 'PYT' and 'Let's Stay Together' and a summer 2018 recap.

serviceDetails.name: DJ Live Experience
serviceDetails.more: The #MADE page presents it as a 'carefully curated' way to supercharge a party, alongside the option to add a sax, violin or trumpet.

serviceDetails.name: #MADE additional performers
serviceDetails.more: The FAQ says they have some of the best musicians and singers on their books, and that whatever line-up a client has in mind, they can make it happen.

serviceDetails.name: Ceremony-to-party music
serviceDetails.more: They invite clients to ask about anything they have in mind for the day, from the ceremony to the full party.

serviceDetails.name: Overseas performances
serviceDetails.more: The duo says it has performed at events abroad before and loves travelling overseas for them.

notes: Fetched 27 Oct 2026. Deposit conflict remains: the FAQ says a 30% non-refundable deposit, while the Book Now page says a non-refundable 50% deposit is required, so neither percentage is stated in the copy. No prices, set lengths, number of sets, power or space requirements, or cancellation terms are published. There is no terms page (only a privacy policy). Instagram, where public gig dates are posted, could not be checked without logging in. Named corporate clients and testimonials on the site were not repeated here.
